title: Bob W Probable NDE 4924
content: As mentioned above at the point of blockage I ceased to breathe. I found myself on the ceiling looking down at a body on a bed. There was a red affect around this body. I was in a profound state of peace and contentment. There was a white light around or near me but I did not stay there very long. Suddenly I was back in my bed awake and conscious of a bed full of prominently claret dominated vomit and the walls and floor decorated in the same unwelcome red detritus. Everything was red! I slowly put it all together. I must have choked and died. Despite the onerous task, at some ridiculous early morning hour, I cleaned up the room in a state of wonderment. I 'knew' that I had died and that death was not at all like the 'religious dominated dogma' and had no fear attached to it. I realized what the red hue was that I saw around the body and that I was the body. I wanted to explain it to all my mates but thought about the odds of them believing me at the pub next day. I was excited but realized that my story would be embellished by pink elephants and etc. if I told it to my friends. So, I held my peace. I was not to know that some years later in 1999, I would start having more profound experiences. I watched my eleven-year-old son die in my arms, my youngest brother die a few weeks later from an accident, and my wife took my thirteen-year-old daughter and vanished. I was able to recall my previous experience and start the process of coming to understand how to survive.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Choked on vomit/airway blockage; ceased breathing.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed body from ceiling; noted a red effect/hue around the body; returned to bed and awoke to vomit.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE from ceiling with peace, brief white light nearby, then sudden return to body/bed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Prominent red hue/affect around the body during OBE; waking to a room covered with claret-colored vomit and interpreting the red hue as related to the body/vomit.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I found myself on the ceiling looking down at a body on a bed.”; “I was in a profound state of peace and contentment.”; “There was a white light around or near me but I did not stay there very long.”; “I 'knew' that I had died and that death was not at all like the 'religious dominated dogma' and had no fear attached to it.”
